hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in *.ts|*.tsx|*.js|*.mjs|*.cjs|*.json) bunx oxfmt "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1 ;; esac; case "$f" in *.ts|*.tsx|*.js|*.mjs|*.cjs) out=$(bunx oxlint "$f" 2>&1) || { echo "$out" >&2; exit 2; } ;; esac; exit 0

if [ "$(jq -r '.stop_hook_active')" = "true" ]; then exit 0; fi; out=$(bun run typecheck 2>&1 && bun run lint 2>&1) || { echo "Typecheck or lint failed. Fix before stopping:" >&2; echo "$out" | tail -40 >&2; exit 2; }; exit 0
